_README: Azure test cell (api-az-test) fixtures for the T5-1.3 live executor. Maps placeholder names from doc curl examples ($AGENT_ID, $ORG_ID, {team_id}, <your-token>, etc.) to known-good values in the Azure test cell. Populated by `node scripts/seed-test-cell-fixtures.mjs --apply` (T5-1.3 v2). Empty values mean those examples skip with 'unresolved placeholder' until a seed runs. Substitution covers $VAR, ${VAR}, <placeholder>, and {template_slot} forms (the last resolves against UPPER_SNAKE_CASE fixture keys, so {org_id} ← ORG_ID).
